general_background.title: Arrival and motion at a growth surface
general_background.summary: In molecular beam epitaxy, incident species reach a surface where adsorption, surface motion and incorporation compete. A species that remains on the surface long enough can migrate to a growth site, while desorption competes with incorporation.
